lead_headline: 23rd Lycian Way Water Walk Held in Kaş
lead_deck: The event took place in Kaş alongside the Patara Yörük Migration.
lead_body: The 23rd Lycian Way Water Walk and Patara Yörük Migration event, organised by Kaş Municipality, has concluded.
The event, which promoted cultural heritage, covered regional walking routes and traditional migration rituals.
